zone.description: The default zone on ZypherOS Kinetic. Incoming connections are refused, except replies to connections this computer made and these services: SSH (sshd is off unless you enable it), mDNS, DHCPv6, printer discovery, Windows share browsing, and KDE Connect. To reach a dev server from another device, open its port, for example: sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=8080/tcp
